title: stardust optimize/findings.json
description: The site-optimization findings ledger. stardust:optimize runs the 7 detection layers and appends findings; the resolving phase (direct/prototype/migrate for design-pass, deploy for platform-migration) flips status to fixed and stamps resolvedBy. Append-only runs[]; findings[] are updated in place by status.

runs.description: Append-only audit trail of optimize invocations.

layer.description: The 7 detection layers ported from the stardust audit.

scopePages.description: Slugs this run covered (empty/absent = whole site).

trigger.description: baseline = after extract; verify = after prototype/migrate; manual = standalone invocation.

check.description: Check id within the layer (e.g. 'ad-hoc-type-scale', 'fragmented-cta-voice', 'computed-contrast', 'cls-layout-shift'). Catalog grows in optimize/reference/checks.md without a schema change.

ids.description: The site (single sentinel), template ids, slugs, or block ids the finding applies to.

evidence.description: The captured, specific evidence (e.g. 'headings 48/44/40/32 cluster at ratio 1.09-1.10' or '21 distinct CTA labels across 2 intent buckets').

fixability.description: design-pass = the redesign fixes it (direct/prototype/migrate). platform-migration = resolved by the platform migration/regeneration (deploy). out-of-scope = infrastructure/TLS/external (informational).

recommendedMove.description: The specific redesign/migration move that resolves it (e.g. 'impose a perfect-fourth modular scale', 'collapse to one canonical primary CTA').

status.description: accepted = acknowledged design-pass finding intentionally left as-is by the user; wontfix = out-of-scope or declined.

contentEdit.description: True when resolving this finding requires a content modification (gates the content-fidelity dial: only design-pass findings in {content-conversion, seo} may justify an optimized-mode edit).

artifact.description: The file that realizes the fix.

firstSeenRun.description: run id where the finding was first detected.
